working_definition: Early female germline cells of the adult ovary preceding the 16-cell cyst stages (germline stem cells, cystoblasts, early cysts) (Li et al. 2022, Manual Annotation; broad class female germline cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that develops into or is itself an egg.

justification: Grouped early-stage call spanning GSC, cystoblast and early cyst cells; most specific common parent is female germline cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Female germline cell and stem cell from which all other female germline cells develop.
Female germline cell which is the daughter of a female germline stem cell.
Female germline cell born during the four rounds of cystoblast division until the presumptive oocyte enters meiosis.

recommendation: Broad match to female germline cell.
